entities.title: What is the Kuiper?
entities.subtitle: Why the code estate became a mathematical address space
entities.description: A plain-English explanation of why Kuiper exists, what a Key means, how the placement law works, and how the visualisation is becoming a procedural computational engine.

entities.title: Learn the Kuiper
entities.subtitle: One circle, one dot, two numbers
entities.description: Move one dot by changing two numbers: one sets the distance through a square root, the other sets the angle through MOD. Slide or type the numbers to steer the dot onto targets, then link them into one key. Six circle sizes, ending with the Kuiper's own constants. The main screen runs offline.

entities.title: Kuiper editions
entities.subtitle: The estate's verified lines of code, lit on the Kuiper wafer
entities.description: Every line of every commit of the estate on one wafer, with the verified lines lit as green sparks at their own keys. Tap a spark or pick a row in LINES to read the line and open it on GitHub at its commit, file and line. Each change is a new dated edition; earlier editions stay as they were. See Through, from the same family, has its own entry just below.

entities.title: See to grid connection probabilities iteratively
entities.subtitle: See Through: from the stars to one substation in 3D
entities.description: Type the name of a UK substation and press GO. The stars gather into the grid, the real map and satellite view appear inside the circle, and an illustrative 3D model of the substation rises on the real ground, combining mapped features with estimates. About 5,800 mapped substations. An early step toward comparing connection options site by site; no connection probability is calculated today. It now also opens from a Kuiper card's link, straight to the right star. Needs the internet.

entities.title: Kuiper diary
entities.subtitle: What it is, what it could become, and why it matters now
entities.description: A short note for anyone meeting the Kuiper for the first time: the two rules behind it, the two things you can open today, where it could go, and how it may help with grid connection in the UK.
